critical_code_review_comments: Wallet cache key is only busted on laggard flip via manual `WALLET_CACHE['ts']=0.0` reset in /api/laggard; the same reset should happen if API keys are hot-reloaded from env. Currently a stale 10s wallet snapshot can outlive a key change.

entry_fx defaults to 0 for legacy Position rows in /api/positions/closed. Consider serializing as null when unset so downstream FX-consistent PnL displays can distinguish 'no FX captured' from a true zero rate.

Round-trip switch to coinswitch produced a valid warning but /api/wallet still returned a shaped response with keys:false and empty balances - good UX; ensure the frontend WalletChip degrades cleanly when balances[] is empty (currently shows '—' fine).
